topic: Analyzing session data for high traffic events
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing sensor data discrepancies during large public events (e.g., Madonna concert, Carnival) where observed traffic increases did not match client expectations or model predictions. Initial hypotheses included permanent device filtering and general crowd density limitations.

Analysis of session data for a specific facility group (company_num 7887, facilities near Copacabana beach) revealed that the count of `is_local` sessions increased significantly, while actual non-local traffic increases were modest. The model was observed to be suppressing local activity when it should have accounted for the spike in local sessions.
decisions: The team will investigate how to incorporate spikes in local session data into the predictive model.
action_items: [p1] will attempt to replicate and review the provided analysis/query results.
